title: 2026 GCF freight-van payload and capacity QA

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Freight LGV factors cover vans up to 3.5 tonnes gross vehicle weight.
Freight LGV factors are derived from vehicle-km conversion factors from the direct-LGV methodology.
Tonne-km freight factors use typical or average capacities and payloads.
Average payload capacities are registrations-weighted rather than simple unweighted model averages.
The methodology uses EEA and VCA van CO2 monitoring datasets covering 2012-2022 registrations.
New-registration information for 2023 is sourced from DfT vehicle-registration statistics.
Vehicle specifications include unladen mass and maximum permitted gross vehicle weight.
Vehicle specifications also include regulatory CO2 emission factors.
Payload estimates differ across fuel and van-size classes.
Fleet payload assumptions are company-reporting methodology inputs rather than parcel-specific freight measurements.
